answer: Attribution decay ledger. A confirmation counts only if the confirmer predates the confirmed account and shares no funding source within two hops, so a tight cluster of new accounts forms a knoll of near-zero weight. Clusters above 30% self-confirmation get escrow frozen and members throttled to slow onboarding — an oasis, not a ban. Attacker cost: a distinct funding trail plus three epochs of latency per surviving identity; reused trails collapse into thin nectar, so volume registration loses yield.
